title: Supreme Court declines stay on SAT verdict exonerating Nusli Wadia, others in fraud scheme case
description: The Supreme Court on Monday sought responses from Wadia Group chairperson Nusli Wadia and textile company Bombay Dyeing on appeals filed by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) against a Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT) ruling that exonerated Wadia and others in a fraudulent scheme case [SEBI Vs Nusli Wadia].The bench of Justices BV Nagarathna and R Mahadevan issued notice on the appeals filed by SEBI against the judgment but declined SEBI’s request to stay the SAT ruling but cla
